purpose: External public-dataset evaluation of the unchanged PhysioNet apdet 1.0.0 method after a predeclared ECG-to-R-R adaptation.

dataset.name: St. Vincent's University Hospital / University College Dublin Sleep Apnea Database

input.channel: the single EDF signal whose trimmed label equals ECG
input.unitsPolicy: Use physical values returned by pyedflib without amplitude rescaling.
input.intervalSemantics: Successive detector R-R intervals are supplied to apdet as normal annotations because UCDDB has no normal-beat classification.
input.adaptationLimitation: Detector R-R is not proven normal-to-normal. This is a locked external adaptation, not an exact input match or Brainstem validation.

quality.completeMinuteBeatCoverage: At least 80% of complete recording minutes must contain at least 20 detected beats.
quality.failurePolicy: Abstain the participant, report the reason, and do not alter thresholds after inspecting outcomes.

reference.positiveTypes: Rows whose type begins APNEA- or HYP-; periodic-breathing-only rows are excluded.
reference.timeAlignment: Interpret event time as time-of-day on the EDF start date, advancing one day when needed to obtain the first time not before recording start.
reference.minuteGrid: Complete non-overlapping minutes from EDF recording start; a minute is positive when any positive event overlaps it by more than zero seconds.
reference.sleepStages: Stages 1 through 5 count as sleep; 0, 6, and 7 do not.
reference.derivedAhi: Count positive respiratory events divided by stage-defined sleep hours.

method.recordThreshold: Detected fraction >= 0.05, evaluated secondarily against derived AHI >= 15.
method.tuning: No parameter, detector, quality threshold, event mapping, record threshold, or metric may change after outcome evaluation. Any change creates a new version and a new external dataset.

participantSeparated: per-participant sensitivity, specificity, balanced accuracy, and accuracy
95% participant bootstrap intervals with 10000 resamples and seed 20260804
calibration: per-participant predicted-positive fraction versus reference-positive minute fraction
secondary: fixed 5% record decision versus derived AHI >= 15 confusion matrix
detected fraction versus derived AHI Spearman correlation

reporting.successThreshold: none; report the locked result regardless of direction
reporting.abstentions: Report participant and public quality reason, with no imputation.
reporting.claims: Public method evidence only. No diagnosis, screening, personal result, Brainstem-device validation, prevalence estimate, AHI estimate for a Brainstem participant, or treatment advice.
